language.name: Aldervale Evening
language.rationale: Tailored for The Aldervale Institute's public affairs programming, balancing institutional authority with evening-news broadcast clarity. Deep navy solidly anchors the lower third, while parchment Source Serif typography and a hairline brass top rule deliver disciplined, scholarly elegance without superfluous decoration.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (airy density - 33/46px padding, 16px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: glide at measured pace → preset mask-wipe
mark ink knocked: the mark reads 1.01:1 on this panel (floor 3) - its single ink is knocked to #ffffff, where it reads 14.89:1 on the panel itself, with no field behind it
